title: 2 Bedroom Private Home w/ Pool
description: Villa Sofia is a vacation rental home located in the surf town of Rincon, Puerto Rico. Enjoy your days at the local beaches and come home to take a dip in the inground pool w/ waterfall. You can continue to soak up the sun on the sundeck. Begin your day with your cup of coffee or end it with a nice glass of wine sitting outside on the terrace under the cool ceiling fans listening to the local coquis. Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

title: Aguada Apartment 1 bed & bath
description: Endless weekend!Escape to the PR's west coast, where ocean views meet mountain ridges. Wake to the sound of roosters and unwind to the coquí's song. Our spacious newly renovated one bedroom apartment fully equipped, is minutes away from top touristic locations like Crash Boat beach, Pico de Piedra, and Gozalandia Falls. Aguadilla Airport is just 30 minutes away.Whether you're seeking relaxation, adventure, or local eats, this is your perfect base. We look forward to your visit.

title: Unique Tiny Home · Plunge Pool · Mountain Views ·
description: Unique tiny home on a private estate in Aguada, PR. Modern design, pool lounge, ocean and mountain views. Fully equipped and furnished. Ideal for couples looking for peace and quiet and nature—just 8 minutes from Rincón and the best beaches on the west coast.The spaceDetached tiny home on a private estate with multiple units. Modern design with high-quality finishes, a fully equipped kitchen, air conditioning, and an outdoor patio with a shared lounge pool.Guest accessGuests have exclusive access to the entire tiny home. Self check-in with a keypad—you can arrive at any time, no problem.Other things to noteThe property is located in a quiet estate in Aguada, surrounded by nature. Although it is an intimate space, it has everything you need for a comfortable and memorable stay in the west coast of Puerto Rico.

title: Casa Sirena
description: Private gated community with a community swimming pool next to the beach. Enjoy our beautiful family home just minutes away from the beach! Whether you're traveling with your partner, family, or friends, this house has everything you will need for a relaxing and invigorating vacation. Our house is fully equipped to accommodateThe spaceSplash your way into the next adventure of your life at Casa Sirena! Located near the end of the Puerto Bahia 2 property, you'll be able to relax in the pure comfort and privacy Rincon has to offer. Enjoy the cool air conditioning while unwinding in either of the 2 bedrooms or while lounging in the main dining room and kitchen area. Also, Enjoy the enchanting Lighthouse down the street!Guest accessEntire House, except the master closet. There is another closet available.Other things to noteMain Gate only works with a key if walking to the beach. There is a beeper available for guests but return before checking out.

title: JV Beachfront Apartments
description: Located right in front of the ocean, this property offers a unique experience with stunning views and the soothing sound of the waves as your backdrop.Equipped with air conditioning, refrigerator and gas stove. One daybed with trundle and one queen size bed.The spaceUPDATE: As of April 27, 2026, the terrace and the staircase providing access to the beach have been fully restored after being affected by strong ocean waves.In addition, as part of our ongoing commitment to improving our guests’ experience, we recently completed several property upgrades based on feedback from previous stays, including:• Adjusting the shower height for greater comfort• Installing handrails on the entrance and bathroom stairs• Adding new chairs and a table on the balcony to better enjoy the space and ocean viewWe remain committed to making every stay more comfortable, safe, and enjoyable for our guests.Other things to notePlease note that, due to its direct beachfront location, beach access may vary depending on wave conditions, weather, and other maritime factors. At times, there may be more or less sand accumulation, and the beach may or may not be easily accessible or suitable for swimming.

title: Romantic Ocean View Bus with Pool

images.caption: Mini fridge similar to this (without content)

description: This 1 bedroom 1 outdoor bath (please see images) bus combines everything you have always imagined when thinking about your Caribbean vacation. Outdoor living with Amazing Ocean Views. This charming space is the perfect getaway for any couple. An open-air ocean view kitchen and "living room" will make you want to stay forever.The spaceWhat we currently do not have: 1. NO WIFI 2. NO TVWhat we currently provide:- We provide the basic supplies like trash bags and toilet paper to get you started but after that please feel free to drive a minute down the road to Colmado Rodriguez, a small store, for your additional needs. - Queen Bed- Small/Mini fridge for some drinks and other basics- We do not recommend drinking the tap water as we are on a well. Please, make sure to bring drinking water. - BBQ with gas and side stove- AC- Fan- Indoor and outdoor lights as well as solar lantern and flashlights - Small dipping pool with fresh water (not heated)- Hot water in shower-Kitchen utensils- Single private parking spot-Linens and two towels This space is for one or two Adults Only. No children are allowed. No pets are allowed. If more than two people arrive then you reservation will be cancelled immediately. Puerto Rico has occasional power outages and water outages. We provide backup water however we do not have backup power. There are solar lights, flashlights and a solar powered fan in the bus for the event of a power outage. Please, only book if you are willing to accept this rarely occurring event. This very private ROMANTIC BLUE BIRD BUS is a few minutes away from the beach by car. You will find great sandy spots to swim but also one of Puerto Rico's best barreling surf spots in the area during big wave season. If you don't surf then enjoy strolling on the sandy beaches for miles. We will be able to tell you about a few uncrowded local surf spots in the area.Fall asleep to the cool evening breeze and the sounds of the sea. And if you like to sleep in the open then you can just move to our outdoor couch/bed and gaze at one of the clearest star covered skies we have ever seen.And when the hunger hits, drive to the chicken truck a few minutes down the road (...amazing food, ask us where it is...) or jump in the car and drive 8 minutes to Rincon's wide variety of restaurants. Experience excellent authentic Puerto Rican cuisine at the local waterfront restaurant which are only a short 5 minute drive away (GUAYABO TROPICAL). On Sunday's you can drive to the Rincon Farmer's Market and indulge in some of the best and freshest farm food available. There are multiple donation based yoga classes in the community, guided horseback riding on Rincon's hidden trails and beaches, sailing on the "Katarina" sailboat and multiple very professional fishing charter operations. Two of the tennis courts (hard courts) in Rincon are also in decent condition. Groups play there every Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Feel free to join.Rincon also offers the most visited and most colorful art walk on the west coast. Every Thursday artists from all around gather in Rincon to showcase their work. You can always find a treasure to take back from you vacation and on most nights live bands will fill Rincon's streets with local and international vibes.Our Romantic Blue Bird Bus is located in a quiet residential area on a dead end road. It is only 25 minutes to and from Aguadilla airport (BQN) which makes those early morning arrivals and departures much easier (you will know what we are talking about when you book your flights.)San Juan can be a 1.5-2.5 hour drive away depending on traffic. Flights on Cape Air from San Juan (SJU) to Mayaguez (MAZ) are an option and sometimes start at $40 each way.

title: Casa Cruces, private hilltop home, expansive views
description: Mountain breezes and views are endless at this newly renovated hilltop home in Rincón's Barrio Cruces. Casa Cruces offers all the perks of Rincón: Mountain-living tranquility only 10 minutes to beaches and surf breaks. With backup power and water, you can vacation and reside in uninterrupted island culture. The balconies and large windows bring the views to you at every glance. Gated saltwater pool for aquatic fun. Main bedroom has a king bed, guest rooms have queen beds. WiFi: 600 mbps.The spaceStaying in the the top-floor unit of Casa Cruces makes you feel removed from the busier parts of town but immersed in the island's hospitable, vibrant atmosphere. If there is any noise to be heard, it is the sound of goats, grazing cows in the distance, and wind coming through the trees. Every room in the house has its own feeling of style and comfort. Each bedroom has newly installed cedar closets that make unpacking worth it! Work-from-home on the balcony, stream entertainment on the TV, or take siesta after a beach day. The house's perch gives guests privacy and security.The 10 x 20 pool has a 3.5' low end and 5' deep end with a relaxation corner bench and waterfall. The lounge and gazebo seating allow guests to relax in the sun or shade. ***Please note, we ask guests to take complete care and caution when using the pool. Guests are 100% responsible for the safety of all occupants' well being during all pool activities, especially children.*** Please: no diving, jumping, running, or use of glass in and around the pool. The tile around the pool is a natural stone, but may still be slippery during pool usage and rain.Guest accessThe driveway can fit two cars. However, please be careful when backing up to exit the driveway. The space can be tight and require a few extra points in a K-turn.Other things to noteCasa Cruces' neighborhood is 100% residential. We respect the quiet and daily life of our neighbors. No parties, events, or loud, late nights are permitted. Quiet hours are 10 p.m. to 8 a.m.

title: Corcega Beachfront Family Suite
description: Take it easy at this unique and tranquil getaway. Suite 101 at Corcega Beachfront Suites has a plush king size bed, 1 sofa bed, a luxurious bathroom and quaint kitchenette. The best part is the beach view from the private balcony. It is the corner unit too!Corcega Beachfront Suites are tastefully decorated with the discerning traveler in mind. Plush bedding and stylish decor make this the perfect option for those who like the finer things in life.The spaceCorcega Beachfront Suites are tastefully decorated with the discerning traveler in mind, featuring plush bedding and stylish decor. It's the perfect choice for those who appreciate the finer things in life and is equipped with solar panels.Front desk available upon request. Backup power generator ensures comfort at all times.Other things to note**Please note that the pet fee is charged per pet, and date changes carry a $50 admin fee. **We have umbrellas, towels, and beach chairs available for rent.
